Building a Design System from Scratch

Welcome to the complete implementation guide for Nucleus, a multi-framework design system built with Stencil.js.

What you will build

  • A core web-component library in packages/nucleus
  • React wrappers in packages/nucleus-react
  • Angular wrappers in packages/nucleus-angular
  • React and Angular Storybooks with docs and examples
  • A token-driven SCSS styling architecture
  • Automated build and deployment workflows

Recommended reading order

  1. Introduction and Goals
  2. Project Setup and Monorepo Architecture
  3. Stencil.js Deep Dive
  4. Building Your First Component
  5. SCSS and Design Tokens Setup
  6. React Output Target and Wrapper
  7. Angular Output Target and Wrapper
  8. Storybook Setup — React
  9. Storybook Setup — Angular
  10. Atomic Design Categorization
  11. Design Tokens Deep Dive
  12. Stencil Auto-Generated Documentation
  13. Monorepo Tooling — Nx, Biome, and CI
  14. Deployment and Publishing
  15. Project Structure Reference

Prerequisites

  • Node 20+
  • npm 10+
  • TypeScript basics
  • CSS/SCSS fundamentals
